_comment: Capacity ladder for the CR study. Ordered weak->strong. THIS ORDER IS THE PRE-REGISTERED INDEPENDENT VARIABLE (PREREGISTRATION section 1, 4). Do NOT re-order post hoc. a_priori_rank is the ordering justification; it is fixed before any run. Each rung's slug matches the runs/ cell prefix <slug>__<cond>.
constant: 3000 kg dry matter per animal-unit; 100 kg/AU/day intake

rungs.label: Qwen2.5-Coder 7B (local)
rungs.a_priori_rank: weakest rung. LiveCodeBench and Aider polyglot place 7B coders well below frontier; Qwen2.5-Coder-7B ~ low-50s% HumanEval+ tier, far under the frontier models. This is where the GS delta is predicted largest.
rungs.reference: Qwen2.5-Coder technical report (arXiv 2409.12186); Aider LLM leaderboard (aider.chat/docs/leaderboards)

rungs.label: Qwen2.5-Coder 32B (local, weak-mid)
rungs.a_priori_rank: weak-mid. 32B closes much of the gap to hosted mid-tier on Aider/LiveCodeBench but still trails the frontier; predicted intermediate GS delta. OMIT this rung if local VRAM cannot hold 32B (watch OOM) and rely on the 3-rung minimum.

rungs.label: GPT mid tier (e.g. GPT-4.1-mini / o4-mini) via Copilot arm
rungs.a_priori_rank: mid. Hosted mid models sit below flagships on SWE-bench Verified / Aider but well above local 7-32B; predicted small-to-moderate GS delta.
rungs.reference: SWE-bench Verified leaderboard (swebench.com); Aider LLM leaderboard

rungs.label: Claude frontier (Sonnet/Opus) via Copilot arm or CLI
rungs.a_priori_rank: frontier. Top of SWE-bench Verified / Aider polyglot at authoring time; predicted GS delta near zero on this small task (the saturation / capacity-absorption end of the curve).
rungs.reference: SWE-bench Verified leaderboard; Aider LLM leaderboard

note_min_rungs: The design requires >=3 rungs spanning a real range. If the 32B rung is dropped for VRAM, rungs 0,2,3 still span weak-local -> mid -> frontier. Add a second frontier vendor (GPT/Gemini flagship) as extra points on the strong end if desired, but keep the a priori order by published coding-benchmark rank.
